plan.notes: Source: Defiance College official "Four-Year Degree Plan" PDF (defiance.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Biology-Plan-of-Study.pdf; file title "2024-25 Plan of Study Biology.xlsx", header "Four-Year Degree Plan Catalog: 25-26"). Catalog year recorded as 2025-2026 per the plan header. Semester credit totals verified against the PDF (17+15+16+14+16+14+15+13 = 120, matching the declared 120 credits). Choice-slot transcription: "Group 1/2 Bio Student Choice" = a 4-credit biology course of the student's choice from the catalog's biology groups; "Sci Elective n/4 300-400 Level" = a 300/400-level science elective of the student's choice; "HPM Gen Ed" / "CEA Gen Ed" = general-education courses of the student's choice in those categories. Specific group/course lists are in the Defiance College catalog, not enumerated in the plan PDF. Degree type: the official Defiance College academic catalog lists Biology among its Bachelor of Science majors. Course titles use the plan PDF's wording (e.g. "College Eng. Sem.", "Intro to Human Comm."); the official catalog titles "College Engagement Seminar" and "Introduction to Human Communication" are confirmed by Defiance's official transfer-pathway documents. SWK 265 Cultural Diversity is categorized as general (gen-ed-coded in the plan; color coding not machine-readable in the extracted text). No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence left empty.
